description: The unexpected date with Sota begins. Fueled by alcohol, Kaoru ends up going into a hotel with him, reminiscing about their childhood. Tall and nicknamed the "Witch of Toyohira," Kaoru often protected the smaller, bullied Sota. Kaoru advised him that if he really fought back, things will work out—but that advice relied on Kaoru`s own physique. What is the surprising suggestion Kaoru makes to Sota who has half-given up...?
